The best of the Emerald Coast is at your fingertips, when staying at our 'Poppy's Place' at Villa Lago vacation rental home in the famous Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort; offering resort accommodation for up to 8 guests in 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms.



 


This home includes the use of a 4 seater golf cart to get around the resort! Don't get stuck in Sandestin without one; it is the best way to make the most out of your Sandestin escape! Please note golf cart is not street legal.*


 


Crown moldings, granite countertops, new furnishings, large flat screen tv's, hardwood floors, new appliances, these are just a few of the qualities that make this home the perfect coastal escape! Jump on the provided golf cart to explore all that Sandestin has to offer. Drive down to the sugar white beach and relax in the translucent waters of the Emerald Coast. Jump in the Villa Lago community pool for a refresh and then grab a bite to eat in the nearby Baytown Wharf.


 


The Villa Lago community is the newest community in the Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort. Nestled between Venetian inspired canals and the Baytowne Golf Course, this home radiates rest and relaxation.


 


The community is within a short distance to the beach and walking distance to the Village of Baytowne Wharf. Baytowne Wharf offers a variety of shops, eateries, and entertainment for kids and grownups alike. Additional famous Sandestin golf courses, such as the Links and the Raven, as well as the Grand Boulevard shopping center and Movie Theater are only a short trolley ride away.


 


So what are you waiting for, come experience the best the Emerald Coast has to offer, and stay in the world renowned Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort in the new Villa Lago community at 'Poppy's Place'!


 


This home is on our Resort Linen and Terry Package with guaranteed fresh linen and terry placed at every turn!
(Excludes Beach Towels)

description:
Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Villa Lago, a neighborhood in Miramar Beach. While the natural beauty of Miramar Beach and Destin Beaches can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Big Kahuna's Water and Adventure Park and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Spend some time exploring the area's activities, including golfing.
